message.text: The new notice tests never exercise a rename's old path. Replacing touchedPaths(input.revision.files) here with input.revision.files.map(file => file.path) would still satisfy the tests read.

explanation.what: The new notice tests never exercise a rename's old path. Replacing touchedPaths(input.revision.files) here with input.revision.files.map(file => file.path) would still satisfy the tests read.
explanation.whatToDo: Add a rename case moving packs/a/package.yml to an unread path and assert that packs/a/package.yml still receives a notice.
explanation.whyHere: The notice promises to cover files read at either revision, including a Packwerk file renamed away; checking only the destination silently loses the old file's notice.

properties.failureScenario: Mutate line 592 to build touched from revision.files.map(file => file.path). Rename packs/a/package.yml to docs/saved.yml with identical contents, with the read list containing packs/a/package.yml but not docs/saved.yml. The mutated code emits no notice for the removed Packwerk configuration. The added tests have modifications, additions, deletions and links, but no rename that would distinguish these implementations.
